The '''Executive Board''' of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] was a panel of [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] who ran the company.

==History==
One of [[Huoba Neva]]'s [[Huoba Neva's parent|parents]] served on the board, which gave Neva the political reliability she needed to enter the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].
